**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Specify benchmark cost aggregation**

When AC8 runs the benchmark at least five times per configuration, this criterion records multiple call-count and elapsed-time observations but does not define how to compare them. The new AC15(d) rule does not resolve this benchmark path because it averages paired differences across real pull-request heads, while a fixture has no PR-head unit and has repeated observations; implementations can therefore use a mean, median, or selected/paired runs and publish conflicting cost-effect claims. Define the aggregation and pairing rule across fixture repetitions, or prohibit a comparative benchmark cost claim.
